title: Vegan chili sin carne with beans and sweet potato
steps: Chop the onion, garlic and pepper, dice the sweet potato small and crumble the tofu.
Fry the onion, garlic and tofu in the oil for 6 minutes, then briefly toast the spices and cocoa.
Add the sweet potato, pepper, tomatoes and rinsed beans and simmer covered for 25 minutes.
Season with salt and lime juice and serve with coriander.
